prompt:
A single vertical Twitch channel "About" panel graphic, full bleed, for a fantasy MMO and anime RPG gaming channel. Look: premium game UI like a high-end modern anime action RPG or MMO menu, painterly and richly detailed, NOT flat vector. Mood: a cozy adventurers' guild tavern — warm, welcoming and lively, like "come in, sit down, we are about to start". Warm lantern and hearth light, polished dark wood, brass fittings, leather, maps. NOT gloomy, NOT gothic, NOT horror, no skulls, no darkness-heavy shadows. Frame: carved warm walnut wood with polished brass/gold corner fittings and small amber gems around the whole panel. Inside: a rich warm dark-brown wood or leather background (#2a1a10 to #1a100a) softly lit in amber, so light text stays very readable. Palette: honey gold (#f5c542), warm amber, candle orange, wine red accents, warm browns; a small touch of teal for contrast. Mature anime RPG art, not cute, not chibi, not cartoonish, not childish, no stickers. TYPOGRAPHY IS CRITICAL: render every text string EXACTLY as written below, in Spanish, letter by letter, with its accents, punctuation and the leading exclamation mark on commands. Crisp, perfectly legible, evenly spaced. Do not add, translate, abbreviate or invent any other text, numbers, logos or watermarks.

HEADER (only the top ~15% of the panel, a short wide strip): a painted scene of an open treasure chest on a tavern table overflowing with gold, gems and a glowing sword, warm lantern light; it blends softly into the panel. Right under the header, centered: the title "LOOT DEL CHAT" in a large carved gold serif (Cinzel-like) with a soft warm glow, and under it a smaller cream line "Botín por estar en el directo". Then one centered paragraph in bright cream-white: "Cada 20-30 min cae un cofre para quien haya escrito hace poco. Va a tu mochila y sale en pantalla." with "20-30 min" in gold. Then one row of 4 small glowing rarity badges, left to right: "Común" (silver-gray), "Raro" (blue), "Épico" (purple), "Legendario" (orange). Then an ornamental divider with the gold section label "Y ADEMÁS", followed by 5 lines, each with a small painted icon on the left and text on the right; the part before the colon (or comma) is bold gold, the rest cream-white: 1 icon a flame: "3 directos seguidos: cofre de fidelidad." 2 icon a small dragon head: "Jefes: todos a !atacar; botín para quien pegue." 3 icon a trophy: "Temporada: cada mes, podio con premio y título." 4 icon a calendar page: "Cada lunes, un evento que cambia las reglas." 5 icon crossed swords: "Duelos, forja y colecciones con título." Then another ornamental divider with the gold section label "SUBS, BITS Y RAIDS", followed by 4 lines in the same style: 1 icon a purple heart gem: "Sub: cofre (legendario al año) y mochila de 30." 2 icon a gift box: "Regalar subs: cofre para ambos; 5+, ¡lluvia de cofres!" 3 icon a faceted diamond: "Bits: 100 = un golpe al jefe; sin jefe, 300 = cofre." 4 icon a shield: "Raid: cofre para quien la trae; con 3+, un jefe." At the bottom, centered and small: "Todos los comandos: !loot" with "!loot" in gold. TEXT SIZE: this panel is shown shrunk to 320 px wide, so text must be LARGE: body lines about 32 px tall, section labels about 34 px, in this 1024 px wide image. Each line may wrap to two lines; keep it left-aligned next to its icon. Use the vertical space for text, not decoration.
